task: Investigate why the job scheduler is running tasks in duplicate. Both scheduler instances report active status.

candidate_memories.content: Only one scheduler instance may hold the distributed leader lease at a time. Any instance that detects it does not hold a valid lease must immediately stop processing and enter standby mode.
Duplicate task execution observed since 09:15 UTC. Both scheduler instances report active=true; the distributed lock may have failed to renew.
Distributed lock renewal interval is every 10 s; if a scheduler misses 3 renewals the lock expires automatically.
Previous duplicate scheduling incident (2025-08) was caused by a network partition preventing lock renewal; check network connectivity between scheduler instances first.
